findings.title: Missing pagination on products list
findings.description: The products.component.ts loads all products without any pagination. For large product catalogs, this will cause significant performance degradation with thousands of records fetched simultaneously.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement server-side pagination in ProductService with limit/offset or cursor-based pagination. Add pagination controls to the template with page size of 20-50 items.

findings.title: No caching for dashboard metrics API calls
findings.description: DashboardMetricsComponent makes two separate API calls (getDashboardMetrics, getSalesDashboardMetrics) every time the component initializes. These values change infrequently but are fetched repeatedly on navigation.
findings.suggested_fix: Add caching to SupabaseService methods with a TTL (e.g., 5 minutes) using RxJS shareReplay or a simple Map-based cache. Reuse cached data if available and not expired.

findings.title: Missing pagination on sales history
findings.description: The analysis component loads all sales history for a given month without pagination. For high-volume retail, this could result in hundreds or thousands of records being loaded at once.
findings.suggested_fix: Implement pagination in getSalesHistory with page/limit parameters. Load initial 50 records and implement infinite scroll or pagination controls for additional pages.

findings.title: Unbounded realtime subscription without throttling
findings.description: The owner-dashboard subscribes to notifications via realtime but loads all unread notifications on init without limiting the result set. Additionally, the activity feed loads last 10 sales with no pagination controls.
findings.suggested_fix: Add .limit(50) or similar to notification queries. Consider adding a 'load more' mechanism for activity feeds.

findings.title: Repeated computation in filter loop
findings.description: The products component filters all products on every search input change without debouncing. This causes unnecessary recalculation on each keystroke.
findings.suggested_fix: Add debounce (300ms) to the onSearch method using RxJS debounceTime operator. This prevents filtering on every keystroke.

findings.title: Missing OnPush change detection strategy
findings.description: Components use default change detection which causes unnecessary re-renders. The dashboard-metrics, activity-feed, and stock-alerts components would benefit from OnPush strategy.
findings.suggested_fix: Add changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush to all display-only components. This reduces change detection cycles significantly.

findings.title: No eager loading of relations in queries
findings.description: The sales history query appears to fetch raw data then map it, but likely doesn't use Supabase's select with related tables (products, users). This causes potential N+1 pattern when accessing s.users?.name and s.products?.name in templates.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Supabase's .select('*, products(*), users(*)') or equivalent to eagerly load related tables in a single query instead of separate requests.

findings.title: Multiple sequential async calls in component init
findings.description: Analysis component makes 5 sequential await calls in ngOnInit, blocking UI render until all complete. These could be parallelized with Promise.all.
findings.suggested_fix: The Promise.all is good but getCurrentUser() is outside it. Move getCurrentUser() inside Promise.all or use Promise.allSettled to prevent one failure from blocking others.

findings.title: Realtime subscriptions without cleanup guarantee
findings.description: StockAlertsComponent starts listening in ngOnInit but the stopListening() is called in ngOnDestroy. If component is destroyed before data loads, there could be a race condition.
findings.suggested_fix: Consider using a subject with takeUntilDestroyed() or a similar pattern to ensure cleanup happens reliably. Also, verify that startListening() properly handles multiple calls.
